blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Face-to-face classes in several localities in Cebu have been suspended on Monday, September 21, as air quality in Metro Cebu remained at the “Acutely Unhealthy” level. The suspensions cover public and private schools in some areas, while other localities left the decision for private schools and its city college to their respective administrators. Here is the list of class suspensions announced as of 6 p.m. on Sunday, September 20: Limit outdoor exposure Class suspensions in Cebu come as the Environmental Management Bureau Region VII (EMB-7) continued to monitor air quality amid transboundary haze from Indonesian wildfires affecting […]...
